006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import java.net.URI;
009
010import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.UriReferenceItemImpl;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * An atomic Metapath item containing a URI reference data value that complies
019 * with RFC2396. URI references can be absolute URIs, relative URIs, or
020 * same-document references.
021 *
022 * @see java.net.URI
023 * @see <a href="https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2396.txt">RFC2396</a>
024 */
025public interface IUriReferenceItem extends IAnyUriItem {
026  /**
027   * Get the type information for this item.
028   *
029   * @return the type information
030   */
031  @NonNull
032  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IUriReferenceItem> type() {
033    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.URI_REFERENCE.getItemType();
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IUriReferenceItem> getType() {
038    return type();
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Construct a new URI item using the provided string {@code value}.
043   *
044   * @param value
045   *          a string representing a URI
046   * @return the new item
047   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
048   *           if the given string violates RFC2396
049   */
050  @NonNull
051  static IUriReferenceItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
052    try {
053      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.URI_REFERENCE.parse(value));
054    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
055      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
056          null,
057          String.format("Invalid URI reference value '%s'. %s",
058              value,
059              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
060          ex);
061    }
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Construct a new item using the provided URI {@code value}.
066   *
067   * @param value
068   *          a string representing a URI
069   * @return the new item as a {@link IUriReferenceItem}
070   */
071  @NonNull
072  static IUriReferenceItem valueOf(@NonNull URI value) {
073    return new UriReferenceItemImpl(value);
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
078   *
079   * @param item
080   *          the item to cast
081   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
082   *         cast to this type
083   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
084   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  static IUriReferenceItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
088    try {
089      return item instanceof IUriReferenceItem
090          ? (IUriReferenceItem) item
091          : item instanceof IAnyUriItem
092              ? valueOf(((IAnyUriItem) item).asUri())
093              : valueOf(item.asString());
094    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
095      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
096      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
097    }
098  }
099
100  @Override
101  default IUriReferenceItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
102    return cast(item);
103  }
104}
